parameters.name: ssh_hook
parameters.description: predefined ssh_hook to use for remote execution. Either `ssh_hook` or `ssh_conn_id` needs to be provided.

parameters.name: ssh_conn_id
parameters.description: :ref:`ssh connection id<howto/connection:ssh>` from airflow Connections. `ssh_conn_id` will be ignored if `ssh_hook` is provided.

parameters.name: remote_host
parameters.description: remote host to connect (templated) Nullable. If provided, it will replace the `remote_host` which was defined in `ssh_hook` or predefined in the connection of `ssh_conn_id`.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: command to execute on remote host. (templated)

parameters.name: conn_timeout
parameters.description: timeout (in seconds) for maintaining the connection. The default is 10 seconds. Nullable. If provided, it will replace the `conn_timeout` which was predefined in the connection of `ssh_conn_id`.

parameters.name: cmd_timeout
parameters.description: timeout (in seconds) for executing the command. The default is 10 seconds. Nullable, `None` means no timeout. If provided, it will replace the `cmd_timeout` which was predefined in the connection of `ssh_conn_id`.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: a dict of shell environment variables. Note that the server will reject them silently if `AcceptEnv` is not set in SSH config. (templated)

parameters.name: get_pty
parameters.description: request a pseudo-terminal from the server. Set to ``True`` to have the remote process killed upon task timeout. The default is ``False`` but note that `get_pty` is forced to ``True`` when the `command` starts with ``sudo``.

parameters.name: banner_timeout
parameters.description: timeout to wait for banner from the server in seconds

parameters.name: skip_on_exit_code
parameters.description: If command exits with this exit code, leave the task in ``skipped`` state (default: None). If set to ``None``, any non-zero exit code will be treated as a failure. If *do_xcom_push* is *True*, the numeric exit code emitted by the ssh session is pushed to XCom under key ``ssh_exit``.

parameters.name: ssh_conn_id
parameters.description: :ref:`ssh connection id<howto/connection:ssh>` from airflow Connections from where all the required parameters can be fetched like username, password or key_file, though priority is given to the params passed during init.

parameters.name: remote_host
parameters.description: remote host to connect

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: username to connect to the remote_host

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: password of the username to connect to the remote_host

parameters.name: key_file
parameters.description: path to key file to use to connect to the remote_host

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: port of remote host to connect (Default is paramiko SSH_PORT)

parameters.name: conn_timeout
parameters.description: timeout (in seconds) for the attempt to connect to the remote_host. The default is 10 seconds. If provided, it will replace the `conn_timeout` which was predefined in the connection of `ssh_conn_id`.

parameters.name: cmd_timeout
parameters.description: timeout (in seconds) for executing the command. The default is 10 seconds. Nullable, `None` means no timeout. If provided, it will replace the `cmd_timeout` which was predefined in the connection of `ssh_conn_id`.

parameters.name: keepalive_interval
parameters.description: send a keepalive packet to remote host every keepalive_interval seconds

parameters.name: banner_timeout
parameters.description: timeout to wait for banner from the server in seconds

parameters.name: disabled_algorithms
parameters.description: dictionary mapping algorithm type to an iterable of algorithm identifiers, which will be disabled for the lifetime of the transport

parameters.name: ciphers
parameters.description: list of ciphers to use in order of preference

parameters.name: auth_timeout
parameters.description: timeout (in seconds) for the attempt to authenticate with the remote_host
